titleEn: Criminal Asset Recovery Act of Brunei Darussalam (Money Laundering Provisions)

articles.en:
(1) Any person performing duties within, or for, the Financial Intelligence Unit shall keep strictly confidential any information obtained in the course of those duties; this obligation of confidentiality continues after the termination of the duties and is subject to exception only where specifically provided by this Act or required by a court.
(2) Any current or former officer of the Financial Intelligence Unit, and any person performing duties within or for the Unit, who breaches the obligation of confidentiality by disclosing information required to be kept confidential under subsection (1) shall be liable to a fine not exceeding 50,000 dollars, imprisonment for a term not exceeding 5 years, or both.
Actions relating to reports or information received

(1) Where the Financial Intelligence Unit has reasonable grounds, on the basis of its analysis and assessment, to suspect that a transaction, a proposed transaction or other activity is related to money laundering, a serious offence or terrorist financing, the Unit may seek the assistance of law enforcement agencies of Brunei Darussalam in respect of any report or of information contained in a report. The Unit may send a copy of the information to the relevant supervisory authorities.
(2) Where the Financial Intelligence Unit has reasonable grounds to suspect that a transaction, a proposed transaction or other activity is related to money laundering, a serious offence or terrorist financing, the Unit may by written direction instruct the reporting institution to continue or to refrain from pursuing the transaction or proposed transaction, for such period as the Unit may determine.
Note:
(a) no written direction shall exceed 5 working days;
(b) no oral direction shall exceed 24 hours, and an oral direction shall be confirmed in writing within 24 hours thereof;
(c) before the expiry of the 5 working days, the Financial Intelligence Unit may apply to a court for an extension of that period.
